October 13, 2026


Cameco was proud to join[Ya'thi Néné Lands and Resources](https://facebook.com/136821083427192) ,[Orano](https://facebook.com/35158880592) and other partners on a recent community tour across Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin to mark the 10-year anniversary of the Ya'thi Néné Collaboration Agreement. Over the past decade, this partnership has helped create meaningful opportunities and shared success across northern Saskatchewan. Looking back on all that's been accomplished reminds us of the power of strong relationships, collaboration and a shared vision for the future. We are grateful for the partnerships we've built and remain committed to working together to support strong, vibrant northern communities for generations to come. #NorthernSaskatchewan[#AthabascaBasin](https://facebook.com/hashtag/AthabascaBasin) #Partnership
